prepare_runtime_absent_optional: {name} was not found (optional: only container stages need it).
prepare_incompatible: Incompatible version: {tool} {version} is outside the range {range} accepted by the adapter {what}. JGates does not change the version by itself.
prepare_fix_incompatible: Install a version of {tool} within the range {range} and run doctor again. There is no automatic downgrade.
prepare_fix_python: Install Python 3.11 or newer and put it on the PATH (or point JGATES_PYTHON), then run jgates doctor --fix, which creates the JGates environment with the quality gate's packages.
prepare_fix_git: Install Git and put it on the PATH.
prepare_fix_docker: Install Docker only if you will use container stages.
prepare_adapter_unknown: The adapter {adapter} is not among the built-in ones; nothing to check.
prepare_not_checked: {tool}: the adapter has no environment check yet.
prepare_tool_no_answer: {tool} at {detail} did not answer the version query.
prepare_lock_drift: The instance {tool} is pinned at {pinned} in {file}, but the installed version is {found}. Check the change before preparing again.
prepare_instance_not_found: The instance {name} does not exist in .jgates/tools.yml.
prepare_not_supported: The instance {name} (adapter {adapter}) has no preparation step.
prepare_not_supported_fix: Run jgates doctor to see what is missing; the fix for each tool appears there.
prepare_rules_invalid: The downloaded content is not a Semgrep rule set ({detail}). Nothing was written.
prepare_lock_invalid_fix: Fix or delete {file} and run the preparation again.
prepare_downgrade: {tool} {found} is older than the version {pinned} pinned in {file}. JGates does not downgrade silently.
prepare_downgrade_fix: Install the pinned version, or accept the version change on purpose with --allow-version-change.
prepare_download_bad_response: The server answered with an error when downloading {url}: {detail}
prepare_download_too_large: The rule set from {url} is too large ({detail} bytes).
prepare_download_insecure_url: Only https (or http on localhost) is accepted to download rules: {url}
prepare_download_fix: Check the network and run the preparation again. Meanwhile, runs continue with the last prepared copy, if any.
prepare_fix_docker_required: Install Docker (or point JGATES_CONTAINER_RUNTIME to the container runtime) and run the preparation again.
prepare_image_runtime_missing: The container runtime {runtime} was not found, and the instance runs in a container.
prepare_image_lock_invalid: .jgates/lock.json is not valid ({detail}), and the image comes only from it.
prepare_image_image_unprepared: The image of {tool} has not been prepared yet (nothing pinned in .jgates/lock.json).
prepare_image_image_missing: The image {image} pinned in .jgates/lock.json is not in the container runtime ({detail}).
prepare_image_image_changed: The image {image} no longer states the version pinned in .jgates/lock.json ({detail}).
prepare_image_required: The instance {name} runs {tool} in a container, and there is no image to prepare.
prepare_image_required_fix: Give the image: jgates tools prepare --instance {name} --image <name:tag or name@sha256:...>.
prepare_image_invalid: The image reference {image} is not valid.
prepare_image_not_found: The image {image} is not in the container runtime ({detail}). Nothing was written.
prepare_image_build_fix: Build the sidecar image (npm --prefix quality-gate run build:image) or give another with --image, and run jgates tools prepare --instance {name} again.
prepare_image_pull_fix: Check the name and the network (the preparation tries docker pull {image} only for a given image), or build the image locally.
prepare_image_no_version: The image {image} does not state the version of {tool} in the label {label}. Nothing was written.
prepare_image_no_version_fix: Use an image built with the tool version label (quality-gate/Dockerfile, jgates/docker/security/Dockerfile or jgates/docker/ruff/Dockerfile).
prepare_docker_stopped: Docker is installed ({path}), but its service does not answer (stopped).
prepare_fix_docker_stopped: Start Docker (jgates doctor --fix offers the system's command).
prepare_sidecar_deps_missing: The Python {python} lacks the quality gate's packages ({packages}).
prepare_recipe_python_missing: there is no Python to create the JGates environment (looked for: {tried}). Install Python 3.11 or newer and run the doctor again.
prepare_recipe_python_old: the Python {python} is {version}, and the JGates environment needs {range}.
prepare_recipe_docker_unknown_system: JGates does not know the install command of this system; follow {docs}.
prepare_recipe_needs_confirmation: a system command, it runs only after a yes on the terminal: {command}
prepare_recipe_no_sudo: the recipe would need sudo, and JGates does not run sudo by itself.
prepare_recipe_venv_hint: On Debian and Ubuntu, the venv module comes in a separate package (python3-venv).
prepare_recipe_needs_docker: the image of {instance} needs a working Docker; install or start Docker first.
prepare_recipe_chosen_by: {variable} chooses the executable ({value}); install into it, or unset the variable so JGates uses its own environment.
prepare_alt_local: the local {tool} ({path}) runs without the image
prepare_alt_container: the image of {tool} pinned in the lock is in Docker
prepare_alt_docker_local: the instances in a container ({instances}) have the local tool
prepare_disable: enabled: false under tools.{instance} in {file} switches the check off for good.
prepare_offer_system_mirrors: the mirrors of the system's package manager
prepare_offer_system: a system command: the command itself asks for sudo; JGates does not run it without your confirmation.
prepare_offer_system_header: System command (sudo asks for the password; --yes does not cover it):
prepare_offer_header_essential: Essential items missing (an enabled check does not run without them):
prepare_offer_header_optional: Optional items missing (there is an alternative):
